Officer's narrative
Upon arrival at the intersection in Katy, Texas, I found a two-vehicle rear-end collision. Driver 1 was stopped in the
right lane when the front of Driver 2's vehicle struck the rear of Driver 1's car. Driver 2 stated that they looked away
from the road briefly and did not notice the stopped traffic in time. Driver 1 was in the driver's seat at the time of
impact, and both I and two independent witnesses confirmed this. Passenger was seated in the rear of Driver 1's
vehicle and was not injured. Driver 1 reported pain in the left shoulder and was evaluated by EMS at the scene. The
reported injury is consistent with the force of a collision of this kind. The rear bumper, trunk lid and tail lamps of Driver
1's vehicle show damage that matches the impact described. I observed no earlier damage to either vehicle, and
none was reported. The witness statements and scene photographs agree with the account given by Driver 2. Driver
1 is the named insured on the policy presented at the scene.
</page>
